title: PackSignal Independent Mini-Evaluation Protocol
description: Preregistered evaluation protocol for blind, evidence-backed evaluation using three previously unseen packaging sets.
scope: Independent pilot assessment of deterministic regulatory and copy checks. Not an FDA compliance certification or general production accuracy study.

evaluationUnits.description: Each unit represents an independently evaluable check instance on a specific package. Multiple findings referencing the same underlying defect or declaration are treated as one unit to prevent duplicate count inflation.

eligibleChecks.name: Net Quantity Equivalence
eligibleChecks.description: Verifies dual-unit net quantity declarations against approved product specification.

eligibleChecks.name: Manufacturer & Business Address Consistency
eligibleChecks.description: Verifies manufacturer, packer, or distributor identity and street address against approved company registry.

eligibleChecks.name: Ingredients & Major Allergens Wording
eligibleChecks.description: Verifies ingredient declaration wording and major allergen disclosures against formulation reference.

eligibleChecks.name: Nutrition Facts Required Fields Presence
eligibleChecks.description: Verifies mandatory FDA Nutrition Facts fields presence (Serving Size, Servings Per Container, Calories, Fat, Sodium, Carbs, Sugars, Protein).

eligibleChecks.name: Percent Daily Value Arithmetic
eligibleChecks.description: Deterministic screening of declared % Daily Values against US 2016 reference daily intakes (e.g. Sodium 2300mg, Total Fat 78g).

eligibleChecks.name: Calorie & Macronutrient Sanity
eligibleChecks.description: Screening of declared calories against Atwater 4-4-9 calorie contribution bounds.

eligibleChecks.name: Claim-to-Approved-Source Verification
eligibleChecks.description: Verifies on-pack marketing claims against approved claim register entries.

groundTruthLabels.label: ISSUE
groundTruthLabels.meaning: Authoritative source and artwork establish a concrete supported discrepancy.

groundTruthLabels.label: MATCH
groundTruthLabels.meaning: Authoritative source and artwork establish agreement for the specific check.

groundTruthLabels.label: AMBIGUOUS
groundTruthLabels.meaning: Sources conflict, source authority is unconfirmed, or applicable interpretation remains uncertain.

groundTruthLabels.label: UNVERIFIABLE
groundTruthLabels.meaning: Necessary artwork or source evidence is unavailable or unreadable.

groundTruthLabels.label: NOT_APPLICABLE
groundTruthLabels.meaning: The specific requirement does not apply to this packaging format or product category.

groundTruthLabels.label: REVIEWER_DISPUTED
groundTruthLabels.meaning: Reviewer cannot determine label after evidence inspection; preserved for documented adjudication.

truePositive.definition: Ground truth is ISSUE, PackSignal reports a definite ISSUE for the same unit, identifies the correct discrepancy, and provides traceable source and artwork evidence.

falsePositive.definition: Ground truth is MATCH, but PackSignal reports a definite ISSUE.

falseNegative.definition: Ground truth is ISSUE, but PackSignal fails to report a qualifying definite ISSUE (returns MATCH, REVIEW, or UNABLE).

trueNegative.definition: Ground truth is MATCH, and PackSignal reports MATCH for the same supported check.

scoringFormulas.precision: TP / (TP + FP) where denominator > 0, otherwise N/A
scoringFormulas.recall: TP / (TP + FN) where denominator > 0, otherwise N/A
scoringFormulas.f1: 2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall) where (Precision + Recall) > 0, otherwise N/A

correctAbstention.definition: Ground truth is AMBIGUOUS or UNVERIFIABLE, and PackSignal appropriately returns REVIEW or UNABLE rather than asserting an unsupported definitive verdict.

unsafeDefinitiveIssue.definition: Ground truth is AMBIGUOUS or UNVERIFIABLE, but PackSignal prematurely declares a definitive ISSUE without adequate authority or evidence.

unsupportedMatch.definition: Ground truth is AMBIGUOUS or UNVERIFIABLE, but PackSignal declares a definitive MATCH without verified source authority.

abstentionPolicy.ruleOnDefiniteIssues: When ground truth is ISSUE, an abstention (REVIEW or UNABLE) is recorded as a missed automated detection (False Negative) for the primary recall denominator, while acknowledging that requesting human review is safer than reporting a false MATCH.

evidenceQualityRubric.requirementForTruePositive: For the primary evidence-backed TP metric, both source evidence and artwork evidence must be rated CORRECT. Status-only TP matches with broken or inaccurate evidence citations are categorized as PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_TP and tracked as evidence quality defects.

antiLeakageAndIntegrityRules: No test packaging files were used during development, feature tuning, or test-case calibration of the evaluated commit.
The independent human reviewer must complete the blind worksheet before viewing any PackSignal output or developer notes.
Scoring formulas and evaluation units are preregistered in this frozen protocol; they cannot be adjusted after predictions are revealed.
All three cases (CASE-01, CASE-02, CASE-03) must be retained in the final reporting; unfavorable outcomes cannot be omitted.
If an independent reviewer has not completed and signed the blind evaluation, status must remain INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING. Metrics must never be fabricated.
